title: Allsky Meteor Peak Hour
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count(eval(event_type="meteor")) as meteors by camera _time
| where meteors>0
| sort - meteors
description: Uses Allsky camera captures telemetry to monitor which hours saw the most meteor detections in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for nights worth reviewing or sharing, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Allsky camera captures data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It totals which hours saw the most meteor detections so you can spot nights worth reviewing or sharing before it becomes annoying.
